headline: Terex Agrees to Sell Aerials Segment to Linamar for $1.4 Billion
summary: Terex Corporation agreed to sell its Aerials segment, including the Genie brand, to Canada's Linamar Corporation for $1.4 billion in cash as part of a strategic portfolio transformation.
why: Terex is an American manufacturer of industrial machinery and lifting solutions, while Linamar is an Ontario-based global industrial and advanced manufacturing enterprise.

impacts.name: Terex
impacts.why: Terex agreed to sell its Aerials segment to focus on higher-margin essential services businesses.
